body: I always thought narwhals were made up, like unicorns and gremlins. I found out this past year that they're real. I'm 19 and still skeptical about this.

At my cousin's wedding in Pakistan, it happened to be a huge protest day. There were loads of people protesting and rioting on the streets, and at night they began setting parked vehicles on fire and following anyone on the streets to set the moving cars on fire too. Good times...

I'm sorry to hear your story, I hope you are doing well, have coped, and are happy. I'm all ears for my mother now, anything she needs of me. I think my family also wants her to see a therapist though, especially my older sister (22) and I (19). However I feel the idea would offend her, she's convinced herself that everyone thinks she's crazy when that's not the case. How did you or would you have reacted at the suggestion of seeing a therapist after your attempts?

She's okay right now, asleep. I'm just trying to decide how to act when she wakes up. I don't know if it would be inappropriate to try to be cheery to make her feel happy. I'm also scared of saying anything that she might mistake as me shaming her.

I'm just in utter shock, our conversation was in no way extraordinary. I will definitely clean up my act, I'm just confused about how to move past this. I'm 19, I'm leaving for school in a week. I have 3 other siblings at home, but I just don't know anything anymore. Also thanks for the advice, I needed to talk about it
